title: A great guide and great driver for an amazing city
text: Both the tour guide and the driver were excellent.  As we requested, we spent a good portion of the tour at the Park Guell.  The tour guide was friendly, knowledgeable, informative, and attentive to our needs.  She made sure we saw all the areas of the park except the hiking trails which we weren’t interested in.  She explained the history of the park very well.  She spoke about Gaudi in detail and very clearly.  We then toured the city in the car. title: Excellent tour!
text: Christine was a wonderful guide!   Made our first visit to Barcelona very special.    Jordy our driver was wonderful as well.
author: Stephanie_B

title: We just finished a half...
text: We just finished a half day tour in Barcelona, and it was perfect as we had time on our own afterwards before heading back to our cruise ship.  Anna was our guide and Jordy was our driver.  They were the most pleasant people and very knowledgeable.  Thank you for the experience.
author: Kelleigh_S

title: Private tour of Barcelona
text: Very knowledgeable,  personal and friendly. Best overall tour of Barcelona not available in group tour.  One still needs tickets to go inside some popular attractions.
author: Robert_S

title: Tour of Barcelona
text: Our tour guide was extremely knowledgeable,  informative, enjoyable,  and overall very pleasant.   Would highly recommend
author: Lori_M

title: Great private tour of Barcelona
text: Our tour guide,Tina, was extremely knowledgeable and amazing.  She customized our tour to take us to the sites we wanted to see, and then some.  She had a lot of valuable insight at each stop.
author: Ralph_S

title: Best tour operator Sasha
text: Our tour guide Sasha was excellent. She has amazing knowledge of the city of Barcelona especially about art history and culture. She was warm accommodating and this tour was amazing thanks to her. We would totally recommend her for any private tours or group tours as one of the best tour guides
author: Prabodh_D

title: Excellent Barcelona Private Tour
text: Great driver and guide made this private tour a very good private tour by being very flexible and accommodative.
author: Gopalan_M

title: Tour of Barcelona with Tina
text: Tina provided an excellent overview of Barcelona. She is knowledgeable and has a friendly personality.  Tina was prompt , well dressed, and had the tour well organized.
author: Paul_K

title: Well worth it!
text: A private tour is the way to go. You choose what you want to do and the guide  and driver are there to make your personalized tour enjoyable. Tickets yo sightseeing spots can be purchased by your tour company prior to the private tour.We had an issue with getting a sightseeing pre-paid ticket through the tour company but eventually it was worked out. Just be sure to let Viator know the sights you want to see and understand the pre-pay ticket process. Our guide Christina was very informative with a great sense of humor.
